name: M-84
protection: T-72-derived composite; M-84AS2 adds domestic M19 ERA, slat armour and soft-kill APS. Game: hull and turret immune to all small-calibre and to 7.62x54R/12.7/14.5 mm (those only break optics, searchlights, external MGs and track pins). Kills need launchers: Javelin/NLAW top-attack, AT4/MAAWS/SMAW or RPG-7 PG-7V to side, rear or roof; frontal ERA defeats single-charge PG-7V.
visual_notes: T-72M silhouette (6 road wheels, low cast turret) - reuse T-72 proportions
Smoke grenade banks in front of the turret; gunner's sight on the turret top-right
M-84AS2: blocky M19 ERA on turret and glacis, slat cages on the rear, laser-warning sensors, RWS on the roof
